llm.summary: This is an instruction-only skill that plausibly just wraps the local 'gws' CLI to send Gmail replies; it requests no credentials itself, but you should inspect the referenced gws-shared auth instructions and the gws binary provenance before installing.

llm.guidance: This skill itself is just documentation that tells the agent to run the local 'gws' CLI to reply to Gmail messages — that is coherent. Before installing: (1) inspect the referenced ../gws-shared/SKILL.md to see how authentication is performed and what OAuth scopes or tokens are required (the security implications live there); (2) verify you trust and control the 'gws' binary on your system (where it came from, its update mechanism, required scopes); (3) be aware that replying with attachments will cause the local CLI to read files you point to, so avoid giving it sensitive local file paths inadvertently; and (4) if you need stronger assurance, request the gws-shared auth details or a signed provenance for the gws binary. If gws-shared requests broad credentials or unusual scopes, treat that as a separate risk.
